description: Live 10-minute measurements from the official MeteoSwiss (SwissMetNet) station network. Choose a parameter and optionally filter to stations near a point (pass both near_lat and near_lon) or by name.

near_lat.description: Optional: WGS84 latitude to sort stations by distance (requires near_lon)

station_name.description: Optional: filter by station name fragment

name: get_current_measurements
title: Live measurements from MeteoSwiss stations
